name: Supply & Demand with Valid Structure
source: TradingLab YouTube — 'The Only Trading Strategy You'll Ever Need'
core_concept: 3-step formula: 1) Identify trend via VALID highs/lows (not just any high/low), 2) Mark supply/demand zones at consolidation before impulse moves, 3) Only trade if R:R > 2.5:1

step_1_market_structure.rule: A low is ONLY valid if it broke the previous high. A high is ONLY valid if it broke the previous low.
step_1_market_structure.uptrend: Valid higher highs and valid higher lows. Only look for LONGS.
step_1_market_structure.downtrend: Valid lower lows and valid lower highs. Only look for SHORTS.
step_1_market_structure.critical: If price breaks a low that DIDN'T break the previous high, it's NOT a valid break. Trend unchanged.
step_1_market_structure.trend_change: Only when price breaks a VALID low (uptrend ends) or VALID high (downtrend ends).

step_2_supply_demand.demand_zone: In uptrend: find consolidation/sideways area BEFORE a sharp move UP. Mark the candle BEFORE the impulse — low to high of that candle.
step_2_supply_demand.supply_zone: In downtrend: find consolidation/sideways area BEFORE a sharp move DOWN. Mark the candle BEFORE the impulse — high to low of that candle.
step_2_supply_demand.entry: Wait for price to RE-ENTER the zone. Enter when it touches.
step_2_supply_demand.stop_loss: Below demand zone (longs) or above supply zone (shorts).
step_2_supply_demand.take_profit: At the recent high (longs) or recent low (shorts).

step_3_risk_reward.rule: Only take trade if R:R > 2.5:1. If zone is valid but R:R < 2.5, SKIP.

priority: HIGH — Maria wants this prioritized above other strategies
